Please read "Before you install" first.

BEFORE YOU INSTALL

Quiet window needed: the core services (the database, the phone switches, messaging and storage, among others) restart once during this update, because they now come back by themselves after a crash or a server restart. Calls in progress drop. Install at a quiet time and tell your teams first.

Refresh browsers: after the update, everyone should reload the console and the agent desk. The stricter browser security below needs the new pages.

Ticket customer notices start switched off for existing organisations. Switch them on under Omnichannel → Tickets → Ticket settings → Customer notifications.

Platform operators all become Owners. Roles can then be set under Platform · Security → Operators.

The admin menu is regrouped by what people come to do, and folds to section titles. Everything is still there, under its new section; the help guides use the new names.

Sign in with Microsoft or Google for mailboxes needs the platform's Microsoft (Entra) and Google apps set up first, under Platform · Channels → Email.

Not yet proven against the real provider: Telesign, Hiya, BMS user matching, CRM deal sync, ad spend from Google Ads and Meta, Yaxxa PBX phase 3, the AI agents studio (Vapi and ElevenLabs; ElevenLabs agents cannot take phone calls yet) and the scale work below. Each works against stand-ins and needs a real account to prove it before customers rely on it.

FOR AGENTS

Tickets: see who else has a ticket open ("Thandi is also replying"); a reply is held back if someone else answered first, unless you send it anyway. Transfer a ticket to a person, team or queue with a note, or forward it by email to anyone, and their reply comes back as an internal note. Merge duplicates, save your own views of the list, change several tickets at once, and log time (with a timer or by hand, billable or not). Reply suggestions offer knowledge articles and quick replies that match what the customer wrote. VIP customers' tickets start one priority higher and carry a badge.

Your picture: choose an illustrated avatar on the desk (Me, or your picture in the header). It shows on the Floor, leaderboards, call records, chats and ticket history. Customers never see one.

On the desk: Mute sits beside Hold, and the state colours match the Floor (available magenta, on a call green, wrap-up yellow, not ready grey). Removing your signature picture asks first.

FOR SUPERVISORS AND ADMINISTRATORS

Ticket customer notices: the customer is told when a ticket is opened (with its number), changes status, is assigned, resolved (with the resolution note if the agent shares it) or closed, each on or off with your own wording. They go on the ticket's own conversation where there is one. Agents can untick "Notify the customer" on a reply.

Customer satisfaction on tickets: when a ticket is resolved, the customer can be asked how it went, by a short email link, or by SMS or WhatsApp with a reply of a number or yes/no. Choose a 1-to-5 or thumbs scale and your own wording. Answers show on the ticket and in Reports → Tickets. Off until you switch it on.

Contract tiers: give business customers a tier (Gold, Silver, Standard or your own names) with its own first-reply and resolution times for each priority, around the clock or in business hours. A customer's tier sets their tickets' due times; changing it re-times their open tickets that are not yet late.

Major incidents: a supervisor marks one ticket as the outage. The console and desk show "There is a known outage", new tickets that look related offer "Link to the incident", one update reaches every linked ticket and its customer, and resolving the incident resolves them all.

Ticket automations (each off to start with): remind the owner after a quiet spell, close tickets left waiting on the customer, escalate on words or priority, start VIP tickets higher. Tags on tickets.
